no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Adaptive Biotechnologies is an MRD diagnostics company (clonoSEQ FDA-cleared assay) plus an Immune Medicine (TCR/BCR sequencing) platform business. It does not own any internal therapeutic drug candidates in active P1/P2/P3 development. The clinical trials listed on ClinicalTrials.gov where Adaptive appears are investigator-sponsored trials at MSKCC, UCSF, Fox Chase, etc. that use clonoSEQ as an MRD measurement tool — not Adaptive-owned drug assets.
